game.title: Kotta Pora
game.description: A thrilling traditional game where two competitors sit on a horizontal pole suspended over mud or water and attempt to knock each other off using pillows. Tests balance and strength.
game.location: Throughout Sri Lanka, especially during festivals
game.occasion: Sinhala and Tamil New Year, village festivals
howToPlay: Step 1: A long horizontal pole is suspended over a mud pit or water body.
Step 2: Two competitors sit astride the pole, facing each other.
Step 3: Each player holds a pillow as their weapon.
Step 4: Players take turns striking each other with pillows.
Step 5: The objective is to knock the opponent off the pole.
Step 6: Players must maintain balance while striking and defending.
Step 7: The last person remaining on the pole wins.
Step 8: Falls are cushioned by mud or water below.
Step 9: The game draws large crowds during festivals.
Step 10: Winners receive prizes and community recognition.
